about: The four days (film-language the_match + the_proof + the_breath): autumn equinox sunset at a gap's edge → the proof of the midwinter sunset, its on-the-line beat a MATCH of the summer one → the Station Stones' Moon → the spring equinox sunrise hidden behind the stones, to black. Script v3.1 act VIII and the coda by hand.

beats.voice: Not every day is marked. At the equinox the Sun sets due west, at the edge of a gap, not inside one.
Four smaller stones mark a rectangle. Its long side points to where the Moon sets at its northernmost, once in 18.6 years.
At the spring equinox the Sun rises due east, behind the stones. The builders aligned their monument to the turning points of the year.
